kind: in-game asset redirection through the game's own loader
finding: The asset container is opened via MSVCP140!_Fiopen (C++ stream open). CreateFileA/fopen/fopen_s/_wfopen slots were patched in 39 modules and logged no asset open, while /proc showed asset/asset held open; intercepting _Fiopen captured it at t_ms=215.
meaning: A mod replaced the file the game's asset loader opened. Because the replacement was a hardlink to the same bytes, the game starting and running normally shows the substitution is transparent; a mod that ships different bytes now has a working path to change game content.
